# Hik-Connect for Teams (HCT) OpenAPI — Capability Router
# Source: Hik-Connect for Teams OpenAPI Developer Guide V2.15.0 (2026-03-06)
# Purpose: Defines capability boundaries, guides AI agents to correct documentation, prevents API invention

## CRITICAL RULES — READ FIRST

1. **DO NOT invent endpoints, fields, or enums.** Every API must come from the
   official documentation in `llms-full.txt`. If a capability is not listed here, it does not exist
   in this version of the API.
2. **Always authenticate first.** All API calls require a valid Token obtained
   from `POST /api/hccgw/platform/v1/token/get`.
3. **Token validity is 7 days.** Refresh proactively before expiry.
4. **Request rate limit: max 5 requests per second.**
5. **All endpoints use HTTPS, JSON format, UTF-8 encoding.**
6. **Base URL pattern:** `https://{areaDomain}:{port}/api/hccgw/{service}/{version}/{path}`
7. **areaDomain varies by region** — see Region Mapping below.
8. **appKey/secretKey must only be used in the local development environment. NEVER commit them to version control, upload to any network, or share with others.** These are sensitive credentials — leakage may lead to unauthorized access to platform resources.
9. **DO NOT invent APIs that don't exist.** Common hallucinations to avoid:
   - `POST /api/hccgw/vims/v1/qr/scan` — QR code scanning is DEVICE-INTERNAL, no API needed
   - `POST /api/hccgw/acs/v1/qr/verify` — QR verification is done by the access controller
   - `POST /api/hccgw/vims/v1/visitor/entry` — Entry logging is device/platform internal
   - `POST /api/hccgw/vims/v1/qr/generate` — QR code is auto-generated by platform on tempauth/add
10. **When a capability is performed by the device/platform internally, NO third-party API is called for it.** If you think you need an API for "scanning", "verifying", or "processing" a QR code — you don't. The device does it.

---

## REGION MAPPING

| Region | areaDomain |
|--------|-----------|
| Singapore / India | `https://isgp.hikcentralconnect.com` |
| Europe | `https://ieu.hikcentralconnect.com` |
| South America | `https://isa.hikcentralconnect.com` |
| North America | `https://ius.hikcentralconnect.com` |
| Russia | `https://hikcentralconnectru.com` |

---

## AUTHENTICATION FLOW (MANDATORY FIRST STEP)

Every integration must start with authentication:

```
POST https://{areaDomain}/api/hccgw/platform/v1/token/get
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "appKey": "{your_AK}",
  "secretKey": "{your_SK}"
}
```

Response:
```json
{
  "errorCode": "0",
  "data": {
    "accessToken": "hcc.xxx...",
    "expireTime": 1655193135,
    "userId": "...",
    "areaDomain": "https://isgp-team.hikcentralconnect.com"
  }
}
```

Then include `Token: {accessToken}` in the request header of ALL subsequent calls.

**IMPORTANT:** Use the `areaDomain` returned in the token response as the base URL for all subsequent API calls. Do NOT hardcode the domain. Example: `https://{areaDomain}/api/hccgw/resource/v1/devices/get`

---

## CAPABILITY MAP — CHOOSE WHAT YOU NEED

### (1) Platform System Services
- **Purpose:** Authentication, system info, service package details, streaming tokens
- **Key endpoints:** token get, system properties, service package, stream token, user list
- **When to use:** You need to authenticate first — all other APIs require a valid Token from this section
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: PLATFORM SYSTEM SERVICES**

### (2) Resource Management
- **Purpose:** Manage physical devices (cameras, NVRs, access controllers, on-board devices, alarm devices), logical areas (hierarchy), and logical resources (cameras, doors, alarm inputs/outputs per area)
- **Key endpoints:** devices CRUD, areas CRUD, cameras/doors/alarm inputs/outputs listing, device detail, device capture, device refresh, timezone, picture upload, ACC status, vehicle management, on-board device management
- **When to use:** You need to discover devices, manage site hierarchy, get device info, capture camera images, manage vehicles/drivers
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: RESOURCE MANAGEMENT**
- **Device categories:** `encodingDevice`, `accessControllerDevice`, `videoIntercomDevice`, `onBoardDevice`, `alarmDevice`
- **Resource types:** `camera`, `door`, `alarmInput`, `alarmOutput`, `vehicle`

### (3) Video Streaming & Recording
- **Purpose:** Live view, playback, recording schedule, MP4 save/download, camera wakeup, thumbnail
- **Key endpoints:** live address/get, playback address/get, recording schedule, MP4 save, playback segment search, download URL, device wakeup, thumbnail
- **When to use:** You need to stream video, play back recordings, or trigger MP4 recording
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: VIDEO STREAMING & RECORDING**
- **Protocols:** RTSP, RTMP, HLS, EZOPEN — RTMP/HLS NOT supported in India or Russia
- **Note:** No-plugin playback (RTMP/HLS) only supported in Singapore, NA, SA, EU. NOT in India or Russia.
- **Note:** When stream encryption is enabled on device, RTMP/HLS protocols don't work, only EZOPEN works
- **Browser video:** Recommend directly integrating JSDecoder SDK (download from https://tpp.hikvision.com/tpp/Resource). EZOPEN protocol requires JS SDK and cannot be played by standard media players.
- **HLS/RTMP:** Only support H.264 encoded streams. Returns standard `.m3u8` (HLS) or `rtmp://` (RTMP) URLs in `playUrl` field.

#### JSDecoder SDK — Step-by-Step Integration Guide

**Prerequisite APIs (call before using SDK):**

1. **Get stream token** — `GET /api/hccgw/platform/v1/streamtoken/get` (Token header required)
   - Returns `appToken` (use as AccessToken in SDK) and `streamAreaDomain` (use as Domain in SDK)
   - Token valid for 7 days

2. **Get device camera list** — `POST /api/hccgw/resource/v1/areas/cameras/get`
   - Use to find `deviceSerial` (use as Serial Number in SDK) and `cameraNo` (use as Channel Number in SDK)

**Required parameters for JSDecoder SDK:**

| Parameter | Source | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| AccessToken | From `streamtoken/get` → `appToken` field | Streaming authentication token |
| Secret Key | Device security code (set when adding device to platform) | Device verification code |
| Serial Number | From `areas/cameras/get` → `deviceSerial` | Device serial number |
| Channel Number | From `areas/cameras/get` → `cameraNo` | Camera/channel index on the device |
| Domain | From `streamtoken/get` → `streamAreaDomain` field | Streaming domain server |

**Integration steps:**

1. Download JSDecoder SDK from https://tpp.hikvision.com/tpp/Resource
2. Include `jsPlugin-3.0.0.min.js` in your web page
3. Initialize the plugin:
   ```javascript
   var oPlugin = new JSPlugin({
     szId: "playWind",      // div container ID
     iWidth: 600, iHeight: 400,
     iMaxSplit: 4,          // max window split count
     szBasePath: "./dist"   // path to SDK dist folder
   });
   ```
4. Set window callback events via `oPlugin.JS_SetWindowControlCallback()`
5. For live view: call `oPlugin.JS_Play("ezopen://open.ezviz.com/{serial}/{channel}.live", {...}, windowIndex)`
6. For playback: call `oPlugin.JS_Play("ezopen://open.ezviz.com/{serial}/{channel}.{local|cloud}.rec?begin=...&end=...", {...}, windowIndex, beginTime, endTime)`

**Note:** JSDecoder SDK requires the page to be served via HTTPS with COOP/COEP headers set (Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin, Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: cross-origin).

### (4) Access Control, Attendance & Personnel Permissions
- **Purpose:** Personnel CRUD, credential management (face/fingerprint/card/PIN), access level assignment, attendance data, remote door open, card swipe records
- **Key endpoints:** person CRUD, credential collection, access level CRUD and person assignment, attendance report, remote control, certificate records search
- **When to use:** You need to add people, assign access permissions, query attendance, open doors remotely, query access events
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: ACCESS CONTROL**
- **Access level APIs use wrapper objects:** `accessLevelSearchRequest`, `personList`, `accessLevel`, `resourceList`

### (5) Visitor Temporary Credentials
- **Purpose:** Temporary access passes for visitors (QR code + password)
- **Key endpoints:** temporary pass add/search/update/delete/list
- **When to use:** You need to grant temporary access to non-resident visitors
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: VISITOR TEMPORARY CREDENTIALS**
- **Core API:** `POST /api/hccgw/vims/v1/tempauth/add` — all device types use the same API to create visitor passes. The only difference between access controllers and video intercoms is which resources (doors/rooms) are linked to the access level.
- **QR code types:** Dynamic (valid 60 seconds, call /get every 60s) and Static (valid entire pass period)
- **ALWAYS ask the developer which QR code type they want** before calling tempauth/add:
  - **Dynamic QR:** Self-refreshing, but requires periodic API calls to /get every 60s. Good for long-duration visits.
  - **Static QR:** Fixed for the entire pass period. No refresh needed. Good for short, one-time visits.
- **If the developer does NOT specify, ask them to choose before proceeding.**
- **PREREQUISITES:** Before creating a visitor pass, the platform MUST have: (1) devices added, (2) access levels created and linked to those devices. The `alIds` field in tempauth/add requires a valid access level ID. If the developer has not set up devices/access levels yet, guide them through RESOURCE MANAGEMENT + ACCESS LEVEL MANAGEMENT first.
- **Access level design:** Ask the developer which doors/entry points the visitor is allowed to use. Create an access level that links exactly those resources. For example:
  - Visitor can only enter through one specific door → create an access level linked to that door's resource ID
  - Visitor can enter through any door in a building → create an access level linked to all door resource IDs in that building
  - Visitor can enter through both an access controller door and a video intercom door → link both resources to the same access level
- **Visitor QR codes are auto-generated by the platform when calling `tempauth/add`. DO NOT use `POST /api/hccgw/person/v1/persons/qrcode` for visitor passes — that API is for registered residents/persons only (requires a personId). Visitor temporary passes do NOT have a personId.**
- **IMPORTANT:** The `name` field in tempauth/add should only contain letters, numbers, and underscores. Some devices do not support special characters like parentheses `()`, Chinese characters, or symbols like `/<>|\*:"`. If credentials fail to push to certain devices, try simplifying the name to just letters and numbers.
- **CRITICAL:** QR code scanning is a DEVICE-INTERNAL operation. The access control device reads the QR and verifies with the platform. Third-party systems do NOT call any API to scan/verify QR codes. DO NOT invent `POST /api/hccgw/vims/v1/qr/scan` or similar — it does not exist.

### (6) Intercom Building, Room & Resident Management
- **Purpose:** Video intercom — buildings, rooms, residents, calls, temporary passes
- **Key endpoints:** building search, room search, resident CRUD, temporary pass, call receive
- **When to use:** You need to manage intercom buildings/rooms, add residents, or handle intercom calls
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: INTERCOM (BUILDING, ROOM & RESIDENT)**
- **Note:** Room information can only be added via HCC/HCT platform — contact technical support for guidance

### (7) Webhook
- **Purpose:** Push-based event notification to third-party servers
- **Key endpoints:** webhook config save/query/delete
- **When to use:** You want real-time event push instead of polling for messages
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: WEBHOOK**

### (8) Alarm Management
- **Purpose:** Alarm subscription, alarm rules, alarm logs, alarm voltage setting
- **Key endpoints:** alarm subscribe/messages/complete, alarm rules CRUD, alarm priorities, receiving schedules, alarm linkage, alarm logs, voltage setting
- **When to use:** You need to configure alarm rules, subscribe to alarms, query alarm logs
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: ALARM MANAGEMENT**
- **Recommendation:** Call messages and messages/complete APIs every 500ms
- Subscription auto-cancels if no messages pulled within 2 days

### (9) Message Management
- **Purpose:** Raw message subscription and receiving (device-initiated events)
- **Key endpoints:** rawmsg subscribe/messages/complete, combine subscribe/messages/complete
- **When to use:** You need to receive raw device messages (not processed by alarm rules)
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: MESSAGE SUBSCRIPTION & PULLING**
- **Message storage:** 2 days by default, subscription auto-cancels if no messages received

### (10) On-Board Monitoring
- **Purpose:** Vehicle and driver management, on-board device management, ACC status, picture upload
- **Key endpoints:** vehicles CRUD, drivers CRUD, driver groups CRUD, driver face distribution/status, ACC status, picture upload
- **When to use:** You need to manage fleet vehicles, drivers, and on-board monitoring devices
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: ON-BOARD MONITORING**
- **Note:** Each on-board device and each vehicle are in one-to-one correspondence

### (11) BI & Analytics
- **Purpose:** ANPR passing records, barrier gate control, customer traffic data
- **Key endpoints:** passing record search, barrier gate control, people flow report
- **When to use:** You need ANPR data, barrier gate control, or foot traffic analytics
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: BI & ANALYTICS**

### (12) Maintenance Services
- **Purpose:** Device offline info, device maintenance status, solar camera wakeup/voltage
- **Key endpoints:** offline info list, device detail, voltage setting, device wakeup
- **When to use:** You need to monitor device health, manage solar-powered cameras
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: MAINTENANCE SERVICES**

### (13) ISAPI Protocol Transmission
- **Purpose:** Transparently forward ISAPI protocol requests from OpenAPI to Hik-Connect
- **Key endpoints:** isapi proxypass, alarm input status get
- **When to use:** You need to send ISAPI commands through the platform
- **→ See `llms-full.txt` section: ISAPI PROTOCOL TRANSMISSION**

---

## DECISION RULES

### Authentication & Setup
### If the user says "get started" or "authenticate"
→ Read PLATFORM SYSTEM SERVICES section first — call token/get to obtain accessToken, then use it as Token header for all subsequent calls

### Device & Area Management
### If the user says "add a device" or "register a camera"
→ Read RESOURCE MANAGEMENT section — call devices/add, then areas/add, then add resource to area

### If the user says "manage devices and areas"
→ Read RESOURCE MANAGEMENT section — devices CRUD, areas CRUD, cameras/doors/alarm inputs/outputs listing

### If the user says "get device info" or "list devices"
→ Read RESOURCE MANAGEMENT section — use devices/get, devices/get detail

### If the user says "get cameras in an area" or "list doors"
→ Read RESOURCE MANAGEMENT section — use cameras/get, doors/get, alarm inputs/get, alarm outputs/get

### If the user says "manage vehicles or drivers"
→ Read RESOURCE MANAGEMENT + ON-BOARD MONITORING sections — vehicles CRUD (add/update/get), driver CRUD + groups, driver face distribution

### Video Streaming
### If the user says "get live video from camera"
→ Read VIDEO STREAMING & RECORDING section — call live address/get, use protocol=1 (EZOPEN) with JS SDK for playback

### If the user says "play back recorded video"
→ Read VIDEO STREAMING & RECORDING section — call live address/get with type=2/3, set startTime and stopTime

### If the user says "download recording as MP4"
→ Read VIDEO STREAMING & RECORDING section — call record/element/search to find segments, then save video as MP4

### If the user says "get recording schedule"
→ Read VIDEO STREAMING & RECORDING section — call recordsettings/get

### Access Control & Personnel
### If the user says "add a person and assign access level"
→ Read RESOURCE MANAGEMENT + ACCESS CONTROL sections — first find device IDs, then person CRUD, then access level assignment

### If the user says "collect face/fingerprint/card for a person"
→ Read ACCESS CONTROL section — use upload person photo, collect fingerprint, collect card APIs

### If the user says "query attendance records"
→ Read ACCESS CONTROL section — search attendance report

### If the user says "open door remotely"
→ Read ACCESS CONTROL section — remote door control

### If the user says "manage access levels or schedules"
→ Read ACCESS CONTROL + RESOURCE MANAGEMENT sections — access level CRUD, schedule template, assign resources and persons

### If the user says "search certificate records"
→ Read ACCESS CONTROL section — search certificate records

### Alarm & Message
### If the user says "subscribe to alarms"
→ Read ALARM MANAGEMENT section — alarm subscribe, poll messages every 500ms, call messages/complete

### If the user says "configure alarm rules"
→ Read ALARM MANAGEMENT section — add alarm rule, set alarm priorities, configure receiving schedules

### If the user says "search alarm logs"
→ Read ALARM MANAGEMENT section — search alarm logs

### If the user says "receive raw device messages"
→ Read MESSAGE SUBSCRIPTION & PULLING section — rawmsg subscribe, poll messages, call messages/complete

### If the user says "set up webhook for real-time events"
→ Read WEBHOOK section — configure webhook URL, then subscribe to alarm or raw message events

### Visitor & Resident Management
### If the user says "grant temporary access to a visitor"
→ Read VISITOR TEMPORARY CREDENTIALS section — add temporary pass with QR code + password

### If the user says "manage intercom residents"
→ Read INTERCOM (BUILDING, ROOM & RESIDENT) section — buildings, rooms, resident CRUD, intercom call receive

### If the user says "manage buildings and rooms"
→ Read INTERCOM (BUILDING, ROOM & RESIDENT) section — building search, room search

### BI & Analytics
### If the user says "search ANPR passing records" or "check license plate data"
→ Read BI & ANALYTICS section — search passing records, control barrier gate

### If the user says "get foot traffic or people flow data"
→ Read BI & ANALYTICS section — get people flow report

### Maintenance & ISAPI
### If the user says "check device health" or "device is offline"
→ Read MAINTENANCE SERVICES section — get offline device info, device maintenance detail

### If the user says "send ISAPI commands"
→ Read ISAPI PROTOCOL TRANSMISSION section — ISAPI proxy pass

### Typical Application Workflows
### If the user says "set up a complete access control system"
→ Read PLATFORM SYSTEM SERVICES (authenticate) → RESOURCE MANAGEMENT (add devices, areas) → ACCESS CONTROL (add persons, collect credentials, assign access levels) → ACCESS LEVEL MANAGEMENT (create access levels, schedules)

### If the user says "build a video monitoring dashboard"
→ Read PLATFORM SYSTEM SERVICES (authenticate) → RESOURCE MANAGEMENT (list devices, cameras) → VIDEO STREAMING & RECORDING (get live/playback URLs) → ALARM MANAGEMENT (subscribe to alarm events)

### If the user says "build a visitor management system"
→ Read PLATFORM SYSTEM SERVICES (authenticate) → VISITOR TEMPORARY CREDENTIALS (add/list/delete passes) → INTERCOM (buildings, rooms, residents)

### If the user says "build a fleet monitoring system"
→ Read PLATFORM SYSTEM SERVICES (authenticate) → ON-BOARD MONITORING (vehicles, drivers, driver groups, face recognition) → BI & ANALYTICS (ANPR records, barrier gate control)

---

## ERROR CODE REFERENCE

All API responses include `errorCode`. The complete list is in `llms-full.txt` section **A.4 Status and Error Code**, organized into 6 categories:

| Prefix | Category | Scope |
|--------|----------|-------|
| CCF | Internal Errors | Person, card, fingerprint, area, device operations |
| EVZ | EVZ Device Errors | Hik-Connect device registration and connectivity |
| LAP | LAP Service Errors | Service calling and timeout |
| VMS | VMS System Errors | VMS platform-wide errors (areas, devices, persons, access levels, ANPR, etc.) |
| THD_ISAPI | ISAPI Device Errors | ISAPI protocol and face picture library operations |
| OPEN | openAPI Errors | OpenAPI gateway, token, resource limits, pagination |

Match the error prefix to identify which subsystem is involved.

---

## DATA FORMAT CONVENTIONS

- **Datetime:** ISO 8601 format, e.g., `2026-07-15T10:30:00+08:00`
- **Boolean:** `true` / `false` (not 0/1)
- **Integer:** numeric type
- **String:** text type
- **Array:** JSON array `[]`
- **Object:** JSON object `{}`

---

## WHAT THIS FILE DOES NOT COVER

- Detailed per-endpoint request/response schemas → see `llms-full.txt`
- Complete data dictionary (AlarmCategory, ResourceType, DeviceCategory, etc.) → see `llms-full.txt`
- ISAPI protocol details → see `llms-full.txt`
- Android/iOS SDK details → see separate SDK documentation

---

## SUMMARY

This router file defines 13 capability areas for Hik-Connect for Teams OpenAPI V2.15.0:
1. Platform System Services (authentication, system info, streaming tokens) — **must use first**
2. Resource Management (devices, areas, cameras, doors, alarms)
3. Video Streaming & Recording (live, playback, MP4)
4. Access Control (persons, credentials, access levels, attendance)
5. Visitor Temporary Credentials (QR code + password)
6. Intercom (buildings, rooms, residents, calls)
7. Webhook (event push to third-party servers)
8. Alarm Management (rules, subscription, logs)
9. Message Management (raw device messages)
10. On-Board Monitoring (vehicles, drivers, on-board devices)
11. BI & Analytics (ANPR, barrier gate, foot traffic)
12. Maintenance Services (device health, solar cameras)
13. ISAPI Protocol Transmission (transparent forwarding)

Read the capability you need from `llms-full.txt` before implementing.
Always authenticate first. Never invent endpoints or fields.
